name: lead-scorer-outreach
description: Manage Lead Scorer CRM data, research prospects, score leads, and prepare outreach drafts for human review.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Lead Scorer account to organize CRM lists, save source-backed research, apply your scoring criteria and prepare personalized outreach drafts. Includes playbooks for prospecting, freelance talent sourcing, enrichment, CRM hygiene and content planning. Uses only data available to your connected account. Enrichment may consume existing Lead Scorer credits, and some features need connected channels or existing account entitlements. Review sources, scores, recipients and message content before use. External messages require human review and approval.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up a reviewed outbound campaign with Lead Scorer.
Check my Lead Scorer account status and tell me the next onboarding step.
Build a source-backed pool of freelance Data Engineers with normalized skills and dated availability.
